configurations.name: dpj-backend
runtimeArgs: cd backend && (test -d .venv || (python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt)) && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

configurations.name: dpj-frontend
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && (test -d node_modules || npm install) && npm run dev
